name: Stadlauer Malzfabrik Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Stadlauer Malzfabrik Aktiengesellschaft, throught its subsidiary, STAMAG Stadlauer Malzfabrik GmbH, engages in the production, manufacture, and sale of baked and confectionery goods, and malt products in Austria. The company was formerly known as ERSTE WIENER EXPORT MALZFABRIK HAUSER & SOBOTKA and changed its name to Stadlauer Malzfabrik Aktiengesellschaft in 1938. The company was founded in 1884 and is based in Vienna, Austria. Stadlauer Malzfabrik Aktiengesellschaft is a subsidiary of IREKS GmbH.
